data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘chau’ which means ‘fort’ or ‘strong’, and ‘dhari’ which means ‘bearer’ or ‘holder’. This name is often given to boys in Hindu communities to symbolize strength, courage, and protection. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi.
